requirements.text: Customers should be able to easily book appointments online by selecting a service, a barber, and a convenient time slot.
The system must display available services clearly, including haircuts, shaves, and styling.
Barbers should have the ability to set and update their own availability to reflect their work schedules, including time off and breaks.
Automated reminders should be sent to customers one day and one hour before their appointments, while barbers should be notified of any cancellations.
A cancellation policy should be implemented, requiring customers to provide at least one day's notice for cancellations.
